knownIssues.detail: The authorized source CSV and verified header/unit mapping are not present in this checkout.
All application codes are unique, but the application subset has 14 more records than IFCT 2017 reports. Source-level reconciliation is unavailable.
Identical normalized English names occur under separate IFCT codes/categories; confirm whether these refer to identical or distinct sampled food items before merging.
